title: GOOD: IMAP PLAIN authzid impersonation rejected
description: stoa-imap session AUTH PLAIN handler rejects any PLAIN message where the authzid (authorization identity, field 0) is non-empty and differs from the authcid (authentication identity, field 1). This prevents a client from authenticating as user A but requesting to act as user B. Correct RFC 4616 compliance; do not remove this check.
